description: Health, lag, throughput, and apply errors for bidirectional Oracle GoldenGate replication between West and East.

options.content: **West → East** is extract **EWEST** and replicat **RWEST** on trail `ew`. **East → West** is extract **EEAST** and replicat **REAST** on trail `ee`. Checkpoint lag is how far that process is behind the change it is reading. Heartbeat lag is end-to-end; heartbeats are written every 60 seconds. Discards, failed conflicts, and integrated batch errors should stay at zero.

panels.title: Process status
panels.description: GoldenGate resource-status running flag. Stopped means the extract or replicat is not applying or capturing.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "resource-status_running" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["resource-name"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "resource-name"])
  |> group(columns: ["resource-name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Caught up
panels.description: End-of-file on the source the process is reading. Caught up means an extract is at the end of the redo stream, or a replicat is at the end of its trail.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position-er_end-of-file" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Checkpoint lag
panels.description: Lag of the last operation processed, in milliseconds. Under 5 seconds is healthy for this lab. Over 30 seconds the path is falling behind. Over 2 minutes it needs attention.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position-er_last-operation-lag" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Heartbeat lag
panels.description: End-to-end heartbeat lag, in milliseconds. The heartbeat table is updated every 60 seconds, so a quiet healthy path sits around that interval. Several minutes means the path is stalled.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heartbeat-timings_heartbeat-lag" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["heartbeat-name"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "heartbeat-name"])
  |> group(columns: ["heartbeat-name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Running history
panels.description: When each extract and replicat was running. A gap is a missed sample, not a clean shutdown.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "resource-status_running" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["resource-name"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "resource-name"])
  |> group(columns: ["resource-name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Replication snapshot
panels.description: One row per process for the selected time range. Rates are the average change per second of the GoldenGate cumulative counters. Sequence and RBA are the extract output trail for EWEST and EEAST, and the replicat input trail for RWEST and REAST.

targets.query:
import "array"
import "join"

wide = union(tables: [
  array.from(rows: [
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Status", _value: -1.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Checkpoint lag", _value: 0.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Heartbeat lag", _value: 0.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Trail sequence", _value: 0.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Trail RBA", _value: 0.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Inserts/s", _value: 0.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Updates/s", _value: 0.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Deletes/s", _value: 0.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Discards", _value: 0.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Failed conflicts", _value: 0.0},
    {process: "_schema", _field: "Batch errors", _value: 0.0},
  ]),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "resource-status_running" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["resource-name"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "resource-name"])
    |> group(columns: ["resource-name"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["resource-name"], _field: "Status", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position-er_last-operation-lag" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["processName"], _field: "Checkpoint lag", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heartbeat-timings_heartbeat-lag" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["heartbeat-name"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "heartbeat-name"])
    |> group(columns: ["heartbeat-name"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["heartbeat-name"], _field: "Heartbeat lag", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trail-output_trail-seq" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["processName"], _field: "Trail sequence", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trail-input_trail-seq" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["processName"], _field: "Trail sequence", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trail-output_trail-rba" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["processName"], _field: "Trail RBA", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trail-input_trail-rba" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["processName"], _field: "Trail RBA", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "statistics-extract_mapped-total-inserts" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
    |> mean()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r.processName, _field: "Inserts/s", _value: r._value}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "statistics-replicat_mapped-total-inserts" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
    |> mean()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r.processName, _field: "Inserts/s", _value: r._value}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "statistics-extract_mapped-total-updates" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
    |> mean()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r.processName, _field: "Updates/s", _value: r._value}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "statistics-replicat_mapped-total-updates" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
    |> mean()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r.processName, _field: "Updates/s", _value: r._value}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "statistics-extract_mapped-total-deletes" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
    |> mean()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r.processName, _field: "Deletes/s", _value: r._value}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "statistics-replicat_mapped-total-deletes" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
    |> mean()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r.processName, _field: "Deletes/s", _value: r._value}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "statistics-extract_total-discards" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["processName"], _field: "Discards", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "statistics-replicat_total-discards" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["processName"], _field: "Discards", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "statistics-replicat_total-conflicts-failed" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["processName"], _field: "Failed conflicts", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group(),
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "batch-sql-stats_total-batches-in-error" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["processName"], _field: "Batch errors", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
    |> group()
])
  |> group(columns: ["process", "_field"])
  |> max()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["process"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

skeleton = array.from(rows: [
  {process: "EWEST"},
  {process: "RWEST"},
  {process: "EEAST"},
  {process: "REAST"},
])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.process =~ /${process:regex}/)

join.left(
  left: skeleton,
  right: wide,
  on: (l, r) => l.process == r.process,
  as: (l, r) => ({
    Process: l.process,
    Path: if l.process == "EWEST" or l.process == "RWEST" then "West → East" else "East → West",
    Role: if l.process == "EWEST" or l.process == "EEAST" then "Extract" else "Replicat",
    Sort: if l.process == "EWEST" then 1 else if l.process == "RWEST" then 2 else if l.process == "EEAST" then 3 else 4,
    Status: r.Status,
    "Checkpoint lag": r["Checkpoint lag"],
    "Heartbeat lag": r["Heartbeat lag"],
    "Trail sequence": r["Trail sequence"],
    "Trail RBA": r["Trail RBA"],
    "Inserts/s": r["Inserts/s"],
    "Updates/s": r["Updates/s"],
    "Deletes/s": r["Deletes/s"],
    Discards: r.Discards,
    "Failed conflicts": r["Failed conflicts"],
    "Batch errors": r["Batch errors"],
  }),
)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.Process != "_schema")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Sort"])

  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurement and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({processName: r.processName, _value: float(v: r._value), _field: "collisions"}))

union(tables: [

  summed(measurement: "batch-sql-stats_total-unique-key-collisions"),
])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> sum()

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Trail sequence
panels.description: Current trail file sequence. Extracts show the file they are writing. Replicats show the file they are reading. The replicat sequence should catch the extract sequence on the same trail.

targets.query:
union(tables: [
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trail-output_trail-seq" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"]),
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trail-input_trail-seq" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")

from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trail-input_trail-rba" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Trail read errors
panels.description: New trail read errors per second on the replicats. These should stay at zero. A sustained rate means the trail file is unreadable or incomplete.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trail-input_trail-read-errors" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "read errors"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: Working set of each GoldenGate process. A climb that never comes back usually means a transaction or cache is being held.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "process-performance_working-set-size" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["processName"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU time consumed by the process, converted from the cumulative microsecond counter. 1.0 is one full core.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "process-performance_cpu-time" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000000.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Telegraf CPU
